verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API documents an API Extract mode for bulk retrieval. It returns JSON or CSV files of up to 1,000,000 records, with the download URL optionally delivered by email, so developers can pull registry extracts without scraping. Sibling public APIs (Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy, Assistance Listings) add further structured access. Missing for 10: evidence of keyless, ready-made public bulk dataset files (extracts require an account-tied API key); bulk download of wage determination data (it is only shown as a lookup); independent or hands-on corroboration of the extract workflow.
